description: Implementation of a project for Joint Genetic Resource Exchange and Development of High-vielding Salinity-tolerance Rice Varieties between                Sri Lanka and Vietnam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the aim of improving the productivity of rice cultivation, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Agriculture Cooperation was entered into between the Department of Agriculture of Sri Lanka and the Vietnamese Academy of Agricultural Sciences on 2025 05 05. Under the said Agreement, the two parties have agreed to implement a project titled ‘Development of High-vielding Salinity tolerance Rice Varieties Project between Sri Lanka and Vietnam’. The activities expected to be carried out under the said project include, exchange of germplasm of rice varieties, conducting joint breeding and hybridization programmes, evaluation and selection of advanced breeding lines under local conditions, establishment of field trials, training of research officers and knowledge exchange between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.
